long_biography.plain_text:
Frances Comer helped bring culture into Chicago’s public spaces. Her suggestion helped create SummerDance in Grant Park, and she backed the Art Institute’s Modern Wing and endowed a curatorial position. She also served as president of the museum’s Woman’s Board.

Her interest in young people led to High School Smarts, an entrepreneurship programme she conceived. She proposed a partnership with DePaul University’s Coleman Entrepreneurship Center, bringing faculty and business founders to work with teenagers. The sessions used practical business ideas and the visitors’ own experiences to show students how they might turn an idea into an opportunity.

Frances Comer helped bring culture into Chicago’s public spaces. Her suggestion helped create SummerDance in Grant Park, and she backed the Art Institute’s Modern Wing and endowed a curatorial position. She also served as president of the museum’s Woman’s Board.

Her interest in young people led to High School Smarts, an entrepreneurship programme she conceived. She proposed a partnership with DePaul University’s Coleman Entrepreneurship Center, bringing faculty and business founders to work with teenagers. The sessions used practical business ideas and the visitors’ own experiences to show students how they might turn an idea into an opportunity.
